name: Gyaruko-chan to Shippori Onsen Ryokou ~H Shimakuri Sanpaku Yokka no Tabi~
original_name: ギャル子ちゃんとしっぽり温泉旅行 ～Hしまくり三泊四日の旅～
source: Main character is single average worker who just retires from his company and plans to visit a popular hot spring to relax. There he meets a beautiful gyaru girl offering him short term relationship in exchange for a place to stay. He agrees to share the room with her thus the sweet time begins for two of them.
translation: 主人公是一名普通的单身上班族，刚刚离开公司，打算去一处知名温泉放松身心。在那里，他遇见了一位漂亮的辣妹。她提出，只要让她有个落脚之处，就愿意与他展开一段短暂的恋情。他答应与她同住一间房，两人的甜蜜时光就此开始。
